summary: 우리나라에서는 2010년 5월 군산과 2026년 5월 백령도에서 사진으로 확인된 매우 드문 길잃은새로, 바닷가 모래밭과 갯벌의 물웅덩이에서 보였다. 예전에는 왕눈물떼새와 한 종으로 다루었으나 유전체 연구에 따라 별개의 종으로 나뉘었다. 파미르고원에서 티베트고원에 이르는 중앙아시아의 높은 산지에서 번식하고, 아프리카 남부·동부에서 동남아시아에 이르는 바닷가에서 겨울을 나며 갯벌에서는 주로 갯지렁이를 잡아먹는다.

points.ko: 흰 무늬 없는 검은 이마·가면(수컷 여름깃)
points.en: solid black forehead and mask with no white on the forehead (breeding male)
bill longer and more slender than Siberian Sand Plover's

sexes.male: 여름깃은 이마 전체가 검어 흰 무늬가 없고, 가슴에 위쪽 검은 테가 없는 밝은 주황색 띠가 있다.
sexes.female: 여름깃의 머리에 뚜렷한 검은색이 없고, 가슴띠도 수컷보다 옅다.

young: 겨울깃 어른새와 비슷하나 몸 윗면과 날개덮깃에 모래빛 담황색 깃 가장자리가 넓고, 가슴 옆 무늬도 담황색을 띤다.

similar.how: 부리가 더 가늘고 길며 다리가 길고, 여름깃 수컷은 이마가 온통 검고 가슴띠 위에 검은 테가 없다.

art.subject: Tibetan Sand Plover (Charadrius atrifrons), adult male in breeding plumage, as on spring passage in May: forehead, lores and a broad mask through the eye to the ear-coverts solid black, with no white on the forehead; crown and nape grey-brown washed rufous-orange; upperparts plain grey-brown; chin and throat white, meeting the breast band in a clean edge with no black line between them; a broad, bright rufous-orange band across the breast, reaching onto the sides of the neck; rest of the underparts white. Bill black, fairly slender and pointed, longer and finer than Siberian Sand Plover's; dark eye; legs dark grey.
art.pose: standing upright on wet sand between short runs, side view
art.scene: Korean west-coast tidal flat and sandy beach in May during spring migration, bright clear morning light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding, side view standing on wet sand: black forehead and broad black mask from the bill through the eye to the ear coverts with no white on the forehead, orange-rufous crown and nape, white throat, broad orange-rufous breast band, plain grey-brown upperparts, white belly, long, slender black bill, relatively long dark grey legs

adult male breeding, front view standing upright: solid black forehead and mask meeting above the bill, white chin and throat, broad orange-rufous band across the breast, white belly, relatively long dark legs
art.build: Small, plump, short-necked plover, clearly larger than Kentish Plover and much smaller than a pigeon; large rounded head and upright stance, running in short bursts and stopping abruptly. Bill black, shorter than the head, straight, fairly slender and pointed at the tip, longer and finer than Siberian Sand Plover's. Legs dark grey, medium length. No white collar around the hindneck. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. In flight a narrow white wing-bar, white sides to the rump and tail, and a darker grey-brown centre to the tail.
avoid: Do not paint a white forehead split by a black vertical line, or a thin black line above the breast band; those mark Siberian Sand Plover (Charadrius mongolus), the regular sand plover in Korea.
Do not give it a long, heavy bill or pale yellowish-grey legs; those mark Greater Sand Plover (Charadrius leschenaultii).
Do not paint a white collar around the hindneck or a black breast band, as on Kentish or Little Ringed Plover.
Do not paint a short, thick, blunt-tipped bill with a swollen tip; that is Siberian Sand Plover. The Tibetan's bill is longer, slimmer and pointed.
